title: Time Based Key Value Store
description: Design a time-based key-value data structure that can store multiple values for the same key at different timestamps and retrieve the value at a certain timestamp. set(key, value, timestamp) stores the key-value pair with the given timestamp. get(key, timestamp) returns the value with the largest timestamp <= the given timestamp.
